labelsOnImage: none — built before build-image wrote io.thyrox.image.lifecycle and thyrox.task; podman cannot relabel an image without rebuilding it

stateMachine.owned+required: the only usable lab image; never reclaimed
stateMachine.owned+reproducible+reclaimable: a clean successor built from a committed Containerfile, its history verified by assertImageFreeOf and, if published, pulled back by digest
stateMachine.unowned: no declaration: neither protected forever nor deleted blindly — ownership is declared first

publishableReason: its RUN history records HTTPS_PROXY/https_proxy values and PIP_CERT; assertImageFreeOf refuses it
transitionRequires: successor carries thyrox.task=TASK-THYROX-0747 and lifecycle permanent
